svg.title: Helium-cooled reactor concept — Primary coolant and containment
svg.desc: Primary coolant and containment. 4 equipment references and 3 declared directed connections. Static illustrative symbols; arrows do not show instantaneous flow. This selected view does not include every plant connection.
